name: Beijing Si-Tech Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Si-Tech Information Technology Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive suite of advanced technology solutions throughout China. Their core offerings span cloud computing, big data analytics, the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and intelligent operational management systems. Furthermore, the company provides essential services in cloud networking, 5G technology, and telecommunications. Their extensive portfolio also includes tailored end-to-end solutions for government and enterprise clients, intelligent retail environments, 5G business support for the broadcasting and television sectors, virtual quotient cloud platforms, and sophisticated smart middle station systems, alongside a holistic digital intelligent ecological platform. The firm was founded in 1995 and maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China.
